create_StyleGAN2Loss: create a StyleGAN2Loss instance with generator, discriminator, and training hyperparameters
run_G_forward_pass: run the generator forward pass with latent codes and conditioning via run_G method
run_D_forward_pass: run the discriminator forward pass on real or generated images via run_D method
accumulate_gradients_G_and_D: accumulate gradients for generator and discriminator training phases via accumulate_gradients method
set_alpha_curriculum: set the curriculum alpha value and propagate it to synthesis and discriminator modules
